description: POD-NN training at the production resolution (r = 48, N = 1024, N_T = 240), trimmed design (follow-up 4 item 3): 800/4000 trajectories x lambda_R in {0, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1}, seed 0; best (size, lambda_R) by validation median full-order exact bound, seeds 1, 2; space-time variant (r x r_t) at the best setting, seeds 0-2. Per run: per-epoch train losses, validation metric every val_every epochs (median rigorous reduced bound, CYm:3x3x2 cells, Q = 36), selected epoch. Evaluation: E2_4_podnn_N1024.json.

pilot.design: N = 512, 24 runs planned (2 sizes x 4 lambda_R x 3 seeds, 2000 epochs); stopped after the production N was fixed at 1024: 6 runs (n = 4000, lambda_R in {1, 0.1}, seeds 0-2) reached ~1200 epochs, best validation median reduced bound 5.8-7.7 (rC cells)

torch_numpy_check.description: eta^{X-bar} residual part, torch (TorchReducedCert) vs numpy (ReducedCertificate.per_step) on 5 random reduced trajectories (validation30 projections + 1e-2 noise)
